notes: The federation's own announcement is the whole held document. Its Television Championship ledger separately records Mahlia winning that belt here, in what it calls the first ever Vixens Lockdown, with no opponent named.

appearances.source: the Vixen's Television Championship's own ledger (promotions/obw/archive/vixen-television-championship.html), which names this show as the site of Mahlia's title win in what it calls the first ever Vixens Lockdown
